title: Nutty Savory Ethiopian Lamb Tagine
description: A briny and molten Ethiopian dish featuring mitsuba and render fat, perfect for a solo dinner, this low sodium friendly recipe is a must try for lamb lovers.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the lamb pieces with salt and black pepper.
Heat the rendered lamb fat in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened and lightly browned.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the chopped mitsuba, berbere spice, and chicken broth, and stir to combine.
Cover the Dutch oven and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the tagine for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Remove the tagine from the oven and garnish with chopped peanuts.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
